title: Analyzing Endpoint DLP Scan for a User: Overview

blocks.text: The Overview page (Data Security > Endpoint DLP > Endpoint Data Scan > User Investigation > [click a user] > Overview) provides a user-centric view of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) activity. It highlights key insights about the selected user, including the devices they use, the sensitive data discovered on their endpoints, the sensitive data that was exfiltrated, and the destination details for the user you select on the User Investigation page.
The following sections are available on the Overview page:

blocks.item: User Details: Shows the following user details:
The email address of the user.

User Risk Profile: The risk profile assigned to the user (Low, Medium, High, or Critical). Zscaler analyzes your organization's user behavior trends and builds a risk profile dynamically by assigning a user risk score to each user. To learn more, see Understanding User Risk Score.
Department: The name of the department that the user belongs to.
Groups: The name of the groups that the user belongs to.
Last Update: The date and time when the Endpoint DLP service was last updated for the user.
Inventory: Shows the count for the following user inventory:
Endpoints: The number of endpoints for the user.
Printers: The number of printers for the user.
Removable Storage: The number of removable storage for the user.
Portable Device: The number of portable devices for the user.
Click the number to view the full list of the devices.

Indicators of Intent: Shows a list of intent rules triggered by the user in the last 30 days. You can also see the count for each rule. Click a rule to further analyze the behavior on the Timeline page.
This section is currently in Limited Availability.

Data at Rest: Shows total sensitive files found on the endpoints from the last scan and the number of files discovered for each DLP engine and AI & ML category. You can also view the number of files discovered for each DLP engine and AI & ML category on the endpoints. Click View All to view data for all DLP engines and AI & ML categories in a drawer.

Exfiltrated Data: Shows total exfiltration attempts by the user (allowed and blocked) for activities and incidents for the last 30 days and the split between the DLP engine and AI & ML category. Click View All to view data for all DLP engines and AI & ML categories in a drawer.

Top Destinations: Shows top destinations for activities, incidents, and intent performed by the user in the last 30 days. You can filter this section for a specific Channel, Type, or DLP Engines. Click View All to see all destinations and its total count in a drawer. Click a destination tile to go to the Timeline tab filtered for the selected destination.
